name: Limonest

art.title: An Episode of the Battle of Limonest

summary: Augereau's army, which had held the Rhône valley against the Austrians since January, was beaten before Lyon at Limonest by the Prince of Hesse-Homburg, and Lyon fell next day.

toCome.name: Musnier's Division
toCome.summary: Withdrew when the Austrians got behind it.

toCome.name: Pannetier's Division
toCome.summary: Held Dardilly, and gave it up when its flank was turned, losing its six guns.

toCome.name: Bardet's Division
toCome.summary: On the east bank of the Saône; it covered the retreat.

toCome.name: Digeon's Division
toCome.formation: Cavalry Division, Army of the Rhône
toCome.summary: The army's cavalry, with infantry besides, covering Grange-Blanche and the withdrawal.

toCome.name: Rémond's Reserve
toCome.summary: National Guards, three and a half thousand with nine guns.

toCome.name: Bianchi's Column
toCome.summary: Advanced to La Tour-de-Salvagny; Wied-Runkel's division attacked Pannetier's and drove back Beurmann's brigade.

toCome.name: Wimpffen's Column
toCome.summary: Pressed on Limonest; Mumb's brigade took the heights, Mont Thoux among them.

toCome.name: Hardegg's Column
toCome.summary: On the east bank of the Saône; its hussars charged near Caluire and were driven off.

toCome.name: Hesse-Homburg's Reserve
toCome.summary: Hessians and Austrians, moving up from Les Chères to Dommartin.
